blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `getWebhookActionAndData` method. This belongs to the Payment Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).

This method retrieves webhook event data with the associated payment provider.

Learn more about handling webhook events in [this guide](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/commerce-modules/payment/webhook-events)

children.name: provider
children.description: The ID of the provider to pass the webhook event payload to.

children.name: payload
children.description: The webhook event payload passed to the specified provider.

children.name: headers
children.description: The headers of the webhook request.

types.name: Promise
types.description: Resolves when the webhook event is handled successfully.

children.name: action
children.description: The action that was performed so that Medusa can handle it internally.

children.name: session_id
children.description:
The ID of the payment session in Medusa.
Make sure to store this ID in the third-party payment provider
to be able to retrieve the payment session later.

children.name: amount
children.description: The amount to be captured or authorized (based on the action's type.)
